«وَ سَأَلَهُ» names only a pronoun for the one asked: the Imam named in prev1 («أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ») is taken over as an inherited last link (rule 5, owner ruling).
The asker «سَعِيدٌ اَلْأَعْرَجُ» is written first, as in the example for «و سأله سماعة».

«وَ سَأَلَهُ سَعِيدٌ الْأَعْرَجُ» names the asker; the one asked is only a pronoun, so the Imam is taken from prev1 (rule 5 and the Faqih ruling): prev1 (2841) writes «سَأَلَ أَبَانٌ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» and supplies the speaker
the Imam is the last link, after the asker; nothing in this text names him
